comment: EDIT THIS FILE TO MANAGE YOUR MODS. See INSTRUCTIONS below.

how_to_add_a_mod: 2. Find the category (terrain, structures, tech, optimisation, utility) under 'mods'.
3. Copy any existing { name, description, tip } block.
4. Paste it in the same category and edit the 3 fields.
5. Save. The website updates automatically (hot reload).
To add a whole NEW category: add a new entry to 'categories' with { key, label, color }, then add its key to 'mods'.
how_to_add_a_datapack: Add a { name, category, description } object to the 'datapacks' array.
Category must match an existing category 'key'.

terrain.name: Terralith
terrain.description: Rewrites the overworld with 85+ new biomes, dramatic mountains, hidden caves and towering cliffs.

terrain.name: William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld
terrain.description: Drop-in biome expansion that adds dozens of atmospheric biomes compatible with Terralith.
terrain.tip: Pair with Terralith — they're designed to coexist.

terrain.name: Tectonic
terrain.description: Taller, more epic terrain generation with deeper oceans and massive mountain ranges.
terrain.tip: Climb the alpine biomes for stunning views of spawn.

structures.name: YUNG's Better Structures
structures.description: Overhauls strongholds, dungeons, mineshafts and ocean monuments with richer loot & handmade rooms.
structures.tip: Bring torches — strongholds now have multiple floors.

structures.name: Repurposed Structures
structures.description: Adds biome-specific variants of villages, outposts and fortresses for more immersion.
structures.tip: Snow villages have exclusive loot — raid them early.

structures.name: Towns & Towers
structures.description: Adds unique towns, pillager towers and boat wrecks for exploration rewards.

tech.name: Create
tech.description: Kinetic contraptions, windmills, rail networks and automation using rotating shafts.
tech.tip: Craft andesite alloy early — it's the backbone of every build.

tech.name: Create: Steam 'n' Rails
tech.description: Expands Create with full train networks, signals and passenger carriages.
tech.tip: Lay tracks between friends' bases for instant transport.

tech.name: Applied Energistics 2
tech.description: Digital storage network — store thousands of items in crafted ME drives with craft-on-demand.
tech.tip: Start with a 1k drive + terminal — scale as you go.

tech.name: Immersive Engineering
tech.description: Retro-industrial tech mod with multi-block machines, power lines and dieselpunk aesthetics.
tech.tip: Build a windmill first — it's the cheapest early power source.

optimisation.name: Sodium
optimisation.description: Modern rewrite of the chunk renderer — massive FPS boost with no visual changes.
optimisation.tip: Pair with Iris if you want shaders without losing FPS.

optimisation.name: Lithium
optimisation.description: Game logic and tick optimisations that reduce server and client CPU usage.
optimisation.tip: Safe to install everywhere — no config needed.

optimisation.name: FerriteCore
optimisation.description: Cuts memory usage dramatically by deduplicating BlockStates and NBT data.
optimisation.tip: Expect 20–30% less RAM used with large modpacks.

optimisation.name: Starlight
optimisation.description: Completely replaces the light engine for 10–50× faster light updates.
optimisation.tip: Fixes those annoying dark chunks when exploring fast.

optimisation.name: Entity Culling
optimisation.description: Skips rendering entities that aren't visible through blocks for big FPS gains.
optimisation.tip: Massive help in mob farms and animal-heavy bases.

utility.name: Sophisticated Backpacks
utility.description: Tiered backpacks with upgrades: magnets, pickup, crafting, XP absorption.
utility.tip: Dye your backpack in a crafting table to coordinate team colors.

utility.name: JEI (Just Enough Items)
utility.description: Shows crafting recipes for every item — press R on any item to see how it's made.
utility.tip: Press U to see what an item is used for.

utility.name: Iron Chests
utility.description: Bigger, upgradable chests — iron, gold, diamond tiers.
utility.tip: Iron chests hold 54 slots, diamonds hold 108.

utility.name: Waystones
utility.description: Build public or private waystones to fast-travel between community bases.
utility.tip: Ourcraft has 12 public waystones — explore spawn to discover them.

utility.name: Xaero's Minimap
utility.description: Minimap + fullscreen world map with waypoints and cave visibility.
utility.tip: Press M to open the world map; right-click to place waypoints.

social.name: Chatting
social.description: Modern Discord-style chat overhaul for Minecraft — emoji, mentions, rich formatting.
social.tip: Press TAB to autocomplete player names and commands.

social.name: PlayerRevive
social.description: Revive teammates who fall in combat before they fully die — real SMP drama.
social.tip: You get 20 seconds to reach and right-click a downed teammate.

social.name: Nameplate Tweaks
social.description: Customisable player nameplates with team colours, prefixes and distance fade.
social.tip: Staff and boosters get unique tags visible in-game.

social.name: Emotecraft
social.description: Fully animated player emotes triggered from a radial menu. Wave, dance, sit.
social.tip: Hold B to open the emote wheel.

datapacks.name: Graves
datapacks.description: When you die, a grave marker is placed at your death location holding your full inventory.

datapacks.name: AFK Display
datapacks.description: Shows an [AFK] tag above idle players so the community knows who's active.

datapacks.name: Custom Recipes
datapacks.description: Crafting recipes for name tags, saddles and elytra repair kits.

datapacks.name: Treasure Maps++
datapacks.description: Adds more variety to cartographer-sold treasure maps including ancient cities.

datapacks.name: More Mob Heads
datapacks.description: Every hostile mob has a chance to drop its head when killed by a player.

datapacks.name: Cross-Dimension Day/Night
datapacks.description: Nether and End skies pulse with synchronized day/night.

datapacks.name: Player Balloons
datapacks.description: Players can tie decorative balloons to themselves on birthdays and events.

datapacks.name: Heart Drops
datapacks.description: Kill-assist mechanic — teammates who help in mob fights share XP.
